name.en: True Wireless Earbuds with Charging Case, Bluetooth 5.3, Glossy White, 6-Hour Playback and 24 Hours with the Case, Touch Controls, Sweat-Resistant, Built-In Microphones for Calls

description.en: Lightweight wireless earbuds that pair as soon as the case opens. Six hours per charge, four more charges in the pocket-size case, and touch controls for music and calls.
description.pt-BR: Fones sem fio leves que pareiam assim que o estojo abre. Seis horas por carga, mais quatro recargas no estojo de bolso, e controles por toque para música e chamadas.
